technique_name: Explain why it is important to understand biases in machine learning models.
description: It is important to understand biases in machine learning models because these biases can often lead to unintended consequences. Bias can occur when a model is trained with data that is not representative of the actual diversity of the population. This can result in models that are inaccurate, unfair, and may even perpetuate existing inequality.
